messages:
maya: Heads-up — I put aegis-13b-mix on the onboarding queue. lightweight blend-trained 13B; good few-shot on our internal synth QA.
lee: Nice. Any initial perf numbers? :eyes:
bench-bot: auto-report: aegis-13b-mix v0.1
- RAG QA (our eval set): F1 0.86 (baseline 0.88)
- Long-form coherence (LLC): 0.79
- Latency (hosted, token): 52ms median @ batch=1
- 8-bit quant (q4f): 42ms median, delta quality: -0.8% exact-match on MMLU subset
- Peak memory (FP16): 28GB
(see /evals/aegis-13b-mix/summary)
sam: baseline model for that workload is atlas-40b in prod, but we're paying much more. This looks promising if quant loss is small.
devon: Can we run the prio rubric? I think we should check roadmap alignment before allocating Dedicated cycles.
ana: Short rubric suggestion in case folks want to copy:
```
Scoring rubric (0-5 each):
- Quality: factuality / eval suite
- Latency: median token latency SLA fit
- Cost: inference tokens/unit (relative)
- Infra fit: memory, quant friendliness, hw mapping
Total = /20
```
lee: I'll throw initial scores: Quality 4, Latency 3, Cost 4, Infra fit 4 => Total 15/20. Comments: quality slightly below atlas, but much cheaper.
maya: +1 on those scores. The LLM team wants cheaper models for embed+rerank pipeline in Q2; that aligns with roadmap.
sam: Quantization note: q4f looks pretty safe from bench-bot numbers, but MMLU drop worth investigating. Could be prompt sensitivity or vocab alignment.
devon: Action items: (1) run focused MMLU diffs with prompt variants (owner: sam) (2) run stress canary on Dedicated dev-pool for 24h (owner: devon) (3) add to A/B roll plan if quality within 1% (owner: maya)
ana: If canary passes, we should consider putting it in the Optimize recommendations as a cost-saving option for search rerank.
lee: Timeline? can we slot canary in next sprint? need 2 GPUs and SRE ok for infra scheduling.
maya: Next sprint sounds fine. devon, can you reserve the 2xA100 dev pool? tag: canary+aegis13b
devon: Will do. scheduling for Mon -> Tue window. I'll post infra reservation in #eng-infra once confirmed.
bench-bot: queued jobs:
- mmlu-diff (prompt variants): ETA 6h
- stress-canary-24h: queued, pending infra reservation
sam: Also adding a quick eval for prompt-sensitivity: 20 prompts x 3 seeds. If we see >1% drop vs atlas on the critical subset, escalate to model gating.
maya: Good. For prioritization doc: given total=15 and roadmap alignment, I'm proposing "priority: medium-high" and move to bring-up sprint. Agree? :thumbsup:
lee: +1
ana: +1
devon: +1
sam: small caveat: if mmlu-diff shows regression, we may pause and open a triage thread.
maya: Agreed. I'll create a follow-up doc for rollouts and merge the eval artifacts into the onboarding folder. thx all.
